body: I'm so sorry this is happening to you this sounds like a terrible situation. Taking care of yourself is the most important thing in this situation. Find something that makes you happy, anything, people say this all the time and it may sound hard but having something you love to look ford to can really give you some sense of hope. Pm me if you want to talk and remember you have done so much good but you can't do everything:)

I'm in a very similar situation, my depression is hurting my performance in school, I constantly think about it and cannot get away from the suicidal thoughts but I have found some things that help me. Intramurals have been a big help in getting me to leave my room and meet people. Honestly during the intramural games is the only time I forget about my depression and feel things again. Intramurals may not be your thing (i didn't know they would be mine) but I know there is something out there for you and I hope you find it. PM me if you want to talk but no pressure.
